title: Day-trader mode: genericize the portfolio risk/exit/profit-target layer's hard-coded weekly/daily split
description:
Follow-up split out of backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode-signal-engine's own checklist item 1 (see that task's `decisions` entry for the full scope-split rationale): that task genericized `app.signals.triple_screen`/`app.signals.engine`'s Screen 1-3 + Impulse + confidence pipeline to operate over whichever `TimeframeTriple` is currently active, but deliberately left `app.portfolio.risk`/`app.portfolio.profit_target`/`app.portfolio.exits` untouched -- these still unconditionally assume swing mode's weekly/daily split regardless of `TradingMode`.

Specifically, still hard-coded today:

- `app.portfolio.risk.protective_stop`'s SafeZone-style stop uses `_SWING_LOW_WINDOW_DAYS` (10 *trading days*, ~2 calendar weeks) as its swing-low lookback window -- meaningless as a literal day-count once the active intermediate/short-term timeframe is intraday (e.g. what does '10 trading days' mean when watching 2-minute bars?). Needs a real methodology decision: a bar-count window scaled to whichever timeframe is active, a wall-clock-duration window resolved generically per `TimeframeInterval`, or something else -- not a mechanical rename.
- `app.portfolio.profit_target.suggest_profit_target`'s channel candidate is explicitly computed from the *weekly* chart (ch. 39 p.161's 'the value zone on a weekly chart presents a good target', per docs/Analyse.md §7's 'Swing-style' profit-target section) -- needs deciding whether day-trader mode's profit target should instead read the active triple's own long-term leg (matching ch. 39's literal 'set profit targets using long-term charts' framing generalized) or whether this rule is swing-mode-specific by design and should simply not apply (or apply differently) in day-trader mode.
- `app.portfolio.exits.evaluate_exit_flags`'s `'tide_flipped_bearish'` flag reads `weekly_ohlcv` directly (a required parameter, not sourced from `app.signals.engine.analyse_day_trader`) -- needs to read whichever data plays the long-term/Tide role for the active mode instead.

Needs an `elder-signal-reviewer` pass before merge, same as its parent task, given this directly touches the 6% Rule/protective-stop risk logic docs/Analyse.md §7 documents and ch. 39 p.161's own long-term-chart profit-target framing.

checklist.step: Decide (and record via `decisions`) how `_SWING_LOW_WINDOW_DAYS`-style bar-count windows should generalize across timeframes -- a fixed bar count regardless of timeframe, a wall-clock-duration-derived count per `TimeframeInterval`, or something else.
Decide (and record via `decisions`) whether `suggest_profit_target`'s weekly-chart channel candidate reads the active triple's long-term leg in day-trader mode, or is scoped to swing mode only.

Genericize `app.portfolio.risk.protective_stop`, `app.portfolio.profit_target.suggest_profit_target`, and `app.portfolio.exits.evaluate_exit_flags` per the decisions above, with swing mode's existing behavior preserved exactly (regression tests, not just new-behavior tests).
Unit/integration tests for the generic risk/exit/profit-target evaluation under day-trader mode, including a mocked IBKR intraday provider where relevant.
elder-signal-reviewer pass before merge -- confirm the 6% Rule/protective-stop/profit-target logic still matches docs/Analyse.md §7 once genericized.
Update docs/architecture/Backend.md §10's 'Not yet landed' list accordingly.
